description: This file defines the LocationMode enum class, representing different location permission modes with associated string values, and includes a companion object with a function to parse raw string inputs into LocationMode instances.

classes.name: LocationMode
classes.description: An enum class representing different location permission states with associated raw string values, including a method for parsing raw string inputs into enum instances.

methods.name: fromRawValue
